tags.name: Dari Laut
tags.qa_note: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-22 (wreck deep-research): re-pulled McFadyen primary source plus 3 new independent sources (puertoparrot.com, scubaspotadvisor.com, plus re-confirmed scubadiverlife.com). Vessel type confirmed across 4 sources as a floating casino/hotel-resort (McFadyen: 'floating casino'; puertoparrot: 'floating hotel-casino-restaurant'; scubaspotadvisor/diveshoppe: 'barge transformed into a floating resort'). CONFLICT: sinking decade disputed -- puertoparrot and scubaspotadvisor place operation/sinking in the 1970s; other sources (incl. prior QA pass) say 1980s. Documented as a conflict rather than picking one. CONFLICT: cause of sinking disputed -- McFadyen's own source presents fire/arson-for-insurance as only ONE of two competing local theories (the other being natural sinking), not a confirmed fact as the prior pass implied. CONFLICT: max depth reported between 25m (McFadyen, frame) and 37m (puertoparrot); scubadiverlife gives water temp 26C vs prior file's 29-30C. No source anywhere gives a vessel name, build date, length, or tonnage -- remain explicitly unknown. All conflicts written into markdown description per anti-hallucination policy rather than guessed.
